about_the_game:
Exertion: The Final Stand in a Dystopian Arena

Exertion is a high-octane roguelike side-scroller set in a dystopian future where AI-controlled war machines have seized the battlefield. As a cutting-edge combat robot, you’ll face relentless waves of deadly drones. Survive a treacherous arena filled with turrets, mines, and enemies by pushing your skills to the limit.

ABILITIES

Defeat enemies to unlock powerful upgrades. Engulf foes in a wall of flames, disrupt their systems with a hack wave, or set a laser trap to outsmart them – craft your own combat style!

CARD SELECTION 

Choose from upgrade cards after each victory. Will you go for devastating firepower, agile maneuvers, or an unbreakable defense? The choice is yours!

BOSS BATTLES

Face off against massive war machines! Each boss brings unique attack patterns that will test your reflexes and strategies to the max.

MORE:

  • A deadly arena packed with turrets, mines, and drones.

  • Take down enemies with unique weapons.

  • Grow stronger with every run.

Play the demo now and dive into the chaos! Arm yourself with powerful weapons, conquer challenging missions, and upgrade your robot with every battle. Your feedback will shape the future of Exertion. Add it to your wishlist now and claim your place in this dystopian war!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 / AMD FX-9590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8500 / AMD Ryzen 5 3500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2070 / AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct X Compatible
